'''Vatoono''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he became one of the guild's top 10 most wanted fugitives, for "accidents" involving the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of some of his Guild colleagues, which turned out to be deliberate murders. An unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked him down and killed him.
